description: This file contains a set of advanced unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, focusing on task execution order, continuation, concurrency, and scheduling behavior within the Orleans framework. It defines the class 'OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests_Set2' with multiple test methods using Xunit, testing various aspects of task scheduling and execution in Orleans.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests_Set2
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for Orleans task scheduler behavior, including task execution order, continuation, concurrency, and scheduling within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: MockSiloDetails
classes.description: A mock implementation of ILocalSiloDetails used within tests to simulate silo details.

methods.name: ActivationSched_SimpleFifoTest
methods.description: Tests that two tasks scheduled on the Orleans scheduler execute in order, verifying FIFO behavior.

methods.name: ActivationSched_NewTask_ContinueWith_Wrapped
methods.description: Tests continuation and scheduling of nested tasks on the Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_SubTaskExecutionSequencing
methods.description: Verifies that sub-tasks execute serially within a task scheduled on Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_ContinueWith_1_Test
methods.description: Tests chained continuations on a task scheduled on Orleans scheduler, verifying execution order.

methods.name: ActivationSched_WhenAny
methods.description: Tests the behavior of Task.WhenAny with tasks scheduled on Orleans scheduler, including synchronization and completion.

methods.name: ActivationSched_WhenAny_Timeout
methods.description: Verifies timeout behavior when waiting for any of multiple tasks scheduled on Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Run
methods.description: Tests that tasks run on the scheduler and complete as expected, verifying task execution context.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Run_Delay
methods.description: Verifies that delayed tasks execute correctly within the Orleans scheduling context.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Delay
methods.description: Tests asynchronous delays within tasks scheduled on Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: DoDelay
methods.description: Helper method to perform an async delay with logging.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Turn_Execution_Order_Loop
methods.description: Stress test to verify that Orleans turns execute serially and no other tasks run concurrently within a turn.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Test1
methods.description: Runs a test involving grain activation and task scheduling, with optional bounce to thread pool.

methods.name: Run_ActivationSched_Test1
methods.description: Internal method executing the core logic of ActivationSched_Test1 with specific scheduler and bounce options.

methods.name: LogContext
methods.description: Logs current task scheduler and synchronization context for debugging.
